title: Red Energy Sorceress Sequence
description: Four sequential poses of a female character with long white hair wearing a red and black outfit, captured mid-action as she manipulates glowing red circular energy magic. The panels show her progressing from conjuring spinning rings to channeling a powerful forward blast that explodes with red particles and light.
prompt: A powerful sorceress with flowing long white hair wearing a dark red and black tactical outfit with red boots, shown in four sequential action poses against a dark gray background. She manipulates bright red circular energy magic, creating spinning rings, thrusting a beam of red light forward, and unleashing an explosive red energy burst with particles and sparks. Dynamic movement, cinematic lighting, dramatic poses, detailed fabric and energy effects.
